paper.title: Risk-aware linear bandits with convex loss

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual (linear) bandits with elicitable risk measures, arbitrary action sets
unmapped: Objective is a risk measure (e.g. expectile, entropic risk) elicited by a convex loss L that is linear in the action: rho_L(Y|x) = <theta*, x>; regret is measured in this risk measure, not the mean
Loss has bounded curvature m <= d^2 L <= M (Assumption 1); the learner knows the loss L and the curvature bounds m, M
Sub-Gaussianity is assumed on the derivative of the loss at theta*, not on the reward noise
settings.definition_quote: we define the pseudo-regret associated to a risk measure $\rho_{\cL}$ and a sequence of actions $\left(X_t\right)_{1\leq t\leq T}$ as $\cR_T\!=\!\sum_{t=1}^T \rho_{\cL}\left(\varphi(\langle \theta^*, X^*_t\rangle)\right)\!-\!\rho_{\cL}\left(\varphi(\langle \theta^*, X_t\rangle)\right)$ ... Theorem~\ref{thm:regret_ucb} holds for arbitrary (potentially adversarial) sequence of action sets

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandits with elicitable risk measures, stochastic i.i.d. action sets with covariance lower bound
unmapped: Objective is a risk measure elicited by a convex loss, linear in the action; regret measured in this risk measure
Loss has bounded curvature m <= d^2 L <= M; learner knows L, m, M
Action sets drawn i.i.d. with conditional covariance of the played action E[X_t X_t^T|F_{t-1}] >= rho_X L^2 I_d (Assumption 6)
settings.definition_quote: Let $\nu_{\cX}$ a probability measure on $2^{\cB^d_{\lVert \cdot \rVert_2}(0, L)}$ ... (i) For $t\in\N$, $\cX_t\sim\nu_{\cX}$ defines an i.i.d. sequence of random action sets. (ii) ... $\bE\left[X_{t} X_{t}^\top \lvert \cF_{t-1} \right]\succcurlyeq\rho_{\cX}L^2I_d>0$.

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual bandits with elicitable risk measures, stochastic action sets (LinUCB-OGD-CR, known horizon)
unmapped: Objective is a risk measure elicited by a convex loss, linear in the action; regret measured in this risk measure
Loss has bounded curvature m <= d^2 L <= M; learner knows L, m, M
Action sets drawn i.i.d. with conditional covariance lower bound rho_X L^2 I_d; the learner knows rho_X (used to set episode length h)
settings.definition_quote: The union bound used in Proposition~\ref{prop:ogd} imposes the knowledge of the horizon $T$ at runtime (in the definition of $\gamma_{t,T}$), thus making Algorithm~\ref{algo::UCB-OGD_convex_risk} not anytime.

symbols.m_curv: lower bound m on the loss curvature d^2 L
symbols.lam: regularisation parameter alpha of the empirical risk minimiser
symbols.c_T: 2*kappa*(sigma*sqrt(2 log(1/delta) + d log(m/alpha) + log det V_T^{alpha/m}) + sqrt(alpha/kappa) S)

conditions: loss L adapted to the bandit (risk measure linear in actions)
bounded loss curvature m <= d^2 L <= M (Assumption 1)
derivative of loss at theta* conditionally sub-Gaussian (Assumption 2); sigma from supermartingale control Lemma 1
tuning: projection Pi onto Theta in F-metric

source.label: thm:regret_ucb
source.quote: Under Assumptions~\ref{ass:loss_curvature}-\ref{ass:subgauss}-\ref{ass:4}-\ref{ass:5}, with probability at least $1-\delta$, the regret of Algorithm~\ref{algo::UCB_convex_risk} is bounded by \[\cR_T \leq 2c^\delta_T \max\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{m}}, \frac{L}{\sqrt{\kappa \alpha}}\right) \sqrt{2Td\log\left(\!1\!+\!\frac{m T L ^2}{d\kappa\alpha}\right)}\,. \]

results.notes: Regret is in terms of the risk measure <theta*, x>; holds w.p. 1-delta. Appendix also gives a global-metric variant with sqrt(kappa/m) scaling (not a formal theorem). Per-round computation requires solving a convex ERM; polynomial assumed.

source.label: thm:regret_ucb_bis
source.quote: Under Assumptions~\ref{ass:loss_curvature}-\ref{ass:subgauss}-\ref{ass:4}-\ref{ass:5}-\ref{ass:6}, with probability at least $1-2\delta$, the regret of Algorithm~\ref{algo::UCB_convex_risk} is bounded by \[\cR_T \leq 4 c^\delta_T\sqrt{\frac{2T}{m \rho_{\cX}}}\left(1 +\frac{C}{\sqrt{T}}\right)\,, \] where $C$ is a constant independent of $T$.

results.notes: Appendix full version (thm:regret_ucb_bis_full) gives explicit C and requires T >= t0 = ceil(8/rho_X^2 log(2/delta) - 2beta/(m rho_X L^2)).

source.label: thm:regret_ucb-ogd
source.quote: Let $\epsilon_h>0$ and $h=\lceil \frac{2\epsilon_h}{\rho_{\cX}L^2} + \frac{8}{\rho_{\cX}^2}\log\frac{2}{\delta}\rceil$. Assume that $\partial \cL(Y_t, \langle\theta^*, X_t\rangle)$ is $\sqrt{m}\sigma$-sub-Gaussian for all $t\leq T$. ... with probability at least $1-(1+T/h)\delta$ the regret of Algorithm~\ref{algo::UCB-OGD_convex_risk} ... satisfies \[\cR_T = \cO\left(\sigma \sqrt{\frac{\kappa dT}{m\rho_{\cX}}}\left(\sqrt{\kappa \log\left(\frac{TL^2}{d}\right)} + h \log\left(dT\right)\right)\right)\,.\]

results.notes: Failure probability grows with T/h, so delta must be chosen ~ h/T. Proof assumes ERM in stable set of projection. Horizon T known (Remark 7).
